messages:
emily: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands earlier. Quick follow-up thread — we heard a lot about why we won and why we lost. Can folks list the top asks from customers and one immediate action we should take? I’ll synthesize and share next steps.

jake: Sales quick take — top loss reason = SSO + data residency; top win = predictable latency and clear cost signals. Action: prioritize SSO + region pinning on shortlist.

sophia: PM note — we currently have SSO for Dedicated but no self-serve SSO for Hosted trials. Need decision on scope (OAuth only vs full SAML/SCIM).

marcel: Eng update — Hosted SSO MVP (OAuth + basic SCIM) needs an auth-proxy + compliance signoff. Rough estimate: 6 wks for MVP if we reduce scope. Region pinning (manual config) ~3 wks; automated routing will take longer.

sales_lead: Example loss: Acme pulled because no SSO during trial and wanted per-route spend visibility. They liked our latency numbers but said security was a blocker.

analytics: Data point from Q4 deals: 42% losses cite security/compliance, 28% cite cost unpredictability, 18% cite latency. Wins: 33% say "predictable latency", 29% say "easy SDKs + streaming".

pri: Solutions/AE playbook idea — offer fast Dedicated POC for top targets while Hosted SSO is in progress. Draft a POC checklist + templated emails for AEs.

engineering_lead: Rollout suggestion — canary SSO with 2-3 customers, add telemetry for login failures and SCIM sync issues, public roadmap entry so customers see progress.

ops-bot: Pipeline update: branch feature/region-pin -> staging merged. CI: ✅, Integration tests: flaky on one test. ETA to prod after fix: 2026-05-12.

emily: Action items captured: 1) PM (sophia) to own SSO scoping; 2) Eng (marcel) to confirm detailed timeline and blockers; 3) Solutions (pri) to draft POC checklist and templated outreach; 4) Sales to collect 3 example losses to attach to roadmap ticket. I’ll compile and send a follow-up doc by EOD.

jake: +1. Could we also get a tiny eval curl snippet AEs can run during calls? e.g.
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health
```

emily: Good call. Marcel, can you pair on the snippet and a 1-paragraph FAQ for "why teams pick Redwood" so AE/Solutions can replicate wins? :thumbsup:
